chunks.title: Revision Log
chunks.heading: Solution › Revision Log
chunks.text:
At grid level context menu at sales order list there is a tool name Revision Log, which is enabled only when a confirmed order is being revised. Revision Log will by default show the Latest revised version and that too modified tab.
Modified Tab:
Now when user clicks on Revision Log a page opens with latest version in modified tab.
Versions are controlled from header level by clicking on dropdown will show all the versions and multi select is also allowed.
Once the user selects the version it will load on the screen simultaneously on all tabs All, Modified & Inserted/Deleted.
Row names will be shown only when changes are done:
Version Change
Revision Authorised By
Reason for Revision
Delivery Name
Delivery Header Detail Changes
Total Qty & UOM
Total Value & Currency
Delivery Quantity Detail
Article
Color & Size
Qty & UOM
Price
Value & Currency
Inserted/Deleted tab:
Version and Deliveries will be left pinned.
Columns name – Version, Delivery Name, Status(Inserted/Deleted), Delivery Buyer Order Ref, Destination, Mode Of Shipment, Delivery Date, Total Qty & UOM(Have an hyperlink that show a pop -up at color/size breakdown of that delivery, it shows those colors and sizes that are been chooses at the time of sales order creation), Total Value & Currency, version Change, Revision Authorized By, Reason for Revision.
All tab:
